title: The Fake Mixtape
author: Wendell Dunmore
blurb: Cyrus Voss, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before the last game of the season.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
